result:
Round 140 passes in the real browser. I found no new bugs, and `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true.

**Code and test checks**
- **Files changed:** only the 16 files the task allowed. None of the other 943 files changed, and the protected auth files are unchanged against commit `3f2c187`. The store's files were identical at the start and end of my checks.
- **Targeted tests:** I re-ran A's 17 test files: 244 of 244 pass, the same as A reported.
- **Code changes:** the four components only had their text swapped. No handler, condition, class, test id or icon changed.
- **Tests:** the new tests use hand-written English text, not values taken from the strings module. A's three edits outside the exact list are small and keep the same checks; B still needs to approve them.

**Browser checks (1440×900 and 1280×720, full run at each: 78 of 78 checks pass)**
- **Envelope:**
  - All the new texts show correctly: the hint, adding, dragging, releasing, deleting and the "nothing changed" message, plus the three Undo labels.
  - Ctrl+Z after moving a point restores it.
  - In real output, a point at −14 dB is 14.0 dB quieter than after Undo at 1440 (14.7 dB at 1280). The task asked for at least 6 dB.
- **Group header:**
  - The new labels are correct, including the singular `ჯგუფი 1 — group, folded, 1 clip` in the real browser and `2 clips`.
  - Folding hides the member clips and unfolding restores them.
  - F2 opens the rename box with the label `Group name — ჯგუფი 1`, and Escape keeps the old name.
- **Group Mute, Solo and Volume:**
  - The labels are correct.
  - In real output, group Mute silences the members completely and unmute restores them.
  - Group Solo silences the track outside the group completely. Ctrl+click Solo on that track adds it back, and it plays at its normal level again.
- **Meters:**
  - With my three test clips, the Master warning did **not** trip at Master 0 dB: the Master Peak read −0.2 dBFS, matching the real output peak of −0.19 dBFS. At Master +6 dB it tripped at +5.8 dBFS and showed the new overload text.
  - I pushed one track over 0 dBFS for real (+12 dB Clip Gain on the full mix, reaching +7.3 dBFS). Its warning title and screen-reader text appeared, and the tracks below 0 dBFS kept the normal title.
  - Clicking Master Peak cleared both warnings without adding an Undo step or changing the status line.
- **Georgian text:** none left in the changed areas at any of the 38 check points. The only Georgian remaining is the default group and track names, demo sound names and the demo-ready message, which later stages translate.
- **Layout:** no element moved more than 1 px against round 139 at either size.
- **Group row layout:** I can't compare it fully, because no round-139 measurement of the group row exists and I can't run the old code. This round changed only the group row's labels and tooltips, not its visible text, and its height of 28 px matches the only older measurement (round 126).
- **Earlier round:** the round-139 track labels still read correctly.
- **Sign-in protection:**
  - `/studio-lab` opens the demo without signing in.
  - `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio loaded.
  - `/api/studio-token` returns 401.
  - The fake-token 403 check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
- **Network and console:** no forbidden requests, no Authorization headers, no hydration errors and no page errors. The only console errors were the known cart messages.

**Notes for B**
- Twice my own script was wrong, not the app: it read the `▣` icon as part of the group name, and +12 dB on the bass clip wasn't loud enough to go over. I fixed both and re-ran. The re-run overwrote the first meter run's files, so the report quotes that run's −1.3 dBFS reading instead.
- An older note (C-R86-OBS) says the default demo peaks above 0 dBFS. The demo now starts empty, so future meter checks need Master +6 dB or a Clip Gain boost.
- **Ableton:** B's sources are only section titles from the manual's table of contents, so whether these behaviours match Live 12 is unconfirmed. Calling it "point" instead of Live's "breakpoint" is a deliberate difference. §38.3 is about CPU overload, so it says nothing about the meter's clip warning.
- Under task §8, V-0.4c can move to `c_pass`. Round 141 is V-0.4d, or the regression round if B plans on or after 2026-10-27.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-140.md
- c-round-140.json
- c-round-140/ (out, shots, tools)
